ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute', ISPICKVAL(Dispute_Reason__c, "Product Defective or Unsatisfactory"), OR( ISBLANK(Customer_Description__c), ISPICKVAL(Goods_Or_Services_Returned__c,''), ISPICKVAL(Goods_Or_Services_Returned__c,'Yes') && ISBLANK(Date_Goods_Were_Returned_Or_Services_can__c), ISBLANK(Merchant_Description__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These fields are required: Customer Description, Goods Or Services Returned and Merchant Description. If Goods or Services Returned is equal to Yes, then Goods Returned or Service Cancelled Date cannot be null.
